frontends.title: C
frontends.blurb: ISO C11 subset. Frozen lexer in PANINI. Lowering and heap eval are host-speed (same slot as CINTERP). This is the kernel compiler path — the host C the rest lower into.

frontends.title: cpp (preprocessor)
frontends.blurb: The preprocessor the kernel and gurucc already use. #define (object and function-like), #ifdef / #ifndef / #if / #else / #endif, #undef, stringizing, ##. Kernel .c files are cpp before cc.

frontends.title: C++
frontends.blurb: cpp.pni is frozen. Work is in cpplower.js. Named extract: enum1.C run + four dg-error files. Not libstdc++.

frontends.title: Python
frontends.blurb: Frozen PANINI frontend. STANDARD GREEN on self-contained CPython asserts. The workbench runs a host-speed def-main subset; Node uses python.pni.

frontends.title: ECMAScript
frontends.sample:
var x = 1 + 1;
if (x !== 2) throw new Test262Error('x');
frontends.blurb: Test262 if/types/addition/unary/logical-not/subtraction. new Object and member assign are in the extract.

frontends.title: TypeScript

frontends.title: Make
frontends.suite: GNU make manual Setting Variables / echo / deps
frontends.sample:
FOO = bar
all: a
	echo $(FOO)
a:
	echo a
frontends.blurb: POSIX/GNU make tokens the kernel build uses: VAR=, ?=, +=, target: deps, tab recipes, $(VAR), $@, $<, $^, ifeq/ifdef, include, obj-y. Not GNU make itself. Not full kbuild.

frontends.title: GNU as
frontends.blurb: AT&T integer subset for kernel .s files. movl/addl/xorl/cmpl/jcc/push/pop/call/ret, directives .globl .text .type .size. Tokens first. Not ld, not ELF.

frontends.title: Kconfig
frontends.sample:
config PANINI
	bool "Panini kernel token"
	default y
	depends on EXPERT
frontends.blurb: Kconfig is how the kernel is configured. Tokens: config, menuconfig, bool, tristate, string, int, hex, default, depends on, select, help, menu, source. Eval applies default y/n.

frontends.title: GNU ld (script)
frontends.blurb: Linker scripts the kernel uses (vmlinux.lds.S class). Tokens: ENTRY, SECTIONS, MEMORY, KEEP, ALIGN, PROVIDE, OUTPUT_FORMAT. Not a linker — tokens + structure, which is what the architect asked for.
